title: Navigate from an authorized Case Timeline row to its separately reauthorized local source preview
goal: Complete the canonical Class-0 Timeline open-source transition for the existing runnable Incident→Case Timeline loopback browser by routing the pre-existing owner-checked synthetic source preview. Display links only for explicit trusted host opt-in, preserve source ACL and original browser history; no new owner, source engine or persistence.
invariants: Existing Investigate Case, Timeline Entry and typed-source owner authority remain the only source of read permissions; browser link is not an authorization token
Only an explicitly trusted server wrapping the already-authorized Timeline handler may opt into source links; default generic timeline HTTP keeps existing HTML and JSON behavior

Links carry only Case ID and already-authorized Entry ID in fixed relative URL /demo-source-open; never raw source reference, permission, principal, tenant, environment, host, Basic secret, arbitrary redirect or user-selected URL
Source preview route delegates unchanged to existing memory owner OpenSource handler, which independently rechecks session, Case, Timeline, linked source identity and atomic source access
No writes, audit persistence, new source, export, production IAM, remote listener, query engine or Class-2 mutation
security_properties: A forged direct source URL never elevates Command-only, anonymous or foreign Case/entry/source identity; errors reveal no private preview
Template-escaped, URL-encoded fixed relative link avoids HTML injection, URL or query mutation; the source URL cannot be supplied by an HTTP parameter
Opt-in marker lives in trusted Go request context only, and only applies to HTML; legacy JSON unchanged, Cache-Control no-store on both routes
No HTML source preview is invented; existing authenticated source handler returns bounded JSON synthetic preview and native browser back restores prior Timeline URL

migration.rationale: Additive optional server-authorized presentation and local loopback route only, no persistent schema change

rollback.strategy: Revert opt-in link and standalone demo route; existing Incident/Timeline handlers and direct Case JSON remain identical
verification: Old Case HTML without host opt-in remains unchanged

outputs: Runnable Case Timeline HTML links to existing /demo-source-open only on explicitly opted-in loopback host, by Case/Entry ID
